name: AXISCADES Technologies Limited
summary: AXISCADES Technologies Limited operates as an engineering solutions company in Europe, the United States, the Asia Pacific, and Canada. It operates through Technology Services and Solutions, and Defence segments. The Technology Services and Solutions segment provides product design, engineering, research and development services. Its Defence segment provides the integration services for defence and offsets business.
